name: EUV C.XNCO PLN
summary: Euvic S.A. provides information technology consulting services in Poland and internationally. The company offers software development services, such as mobile applications, online portals and web applications, product design, product strategy discovery, as well as integration and migration of IT systems. It also provides process automation, including cloud migration, business intelligence, dynamic 365 / business systems, artificial intelligence, AI transformation, AI consultation, and AI solution; IT outsourcing; staff augmentation; and IT infrastructure, audits and consultancy, and migration and deployment.
